layers.name: routes
layers.responsibility: File routes: read params, compose a feature, nothing else

layers.name: features
layers.responsibility: One module per domain: its components, hooks and use cases

layers.name: data-access
layers.responsibility: Typed queries and mutations against Supabase; the only code that knows table names

layers.name: server
layers.responsibility: Server functions and API routes that need a secret or run privileged work

layers.name: ui
layers.responsibility: Presentational components with no data access

layers.name: lib
layers.responsibility: Pure helpers: formatting, dates, money; no I/O

layers.name: config
layers.responsibility: Environment and constants read once, typed

infrastructure_baseline.item: One typed module reads every environment variable once and fails at start on a missing one
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Scattered import.meta.env reads fail at runtime, on the screen that first needs the value.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No file outside the config module reads the environment; a missing variable stops the build or start with its name.

infrastructure_baseline.item: A generated, typed Supabase client (supabase gen types) used only by data-access
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Hand-written table names and shapes drift from the schema silently.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: types.ts regenerates with no diff; no table name outside data-access.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Every push runs lint, type check, tests and the EAOS debt gate
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Without a gate each change can reintroduce what the audit removed.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The default branch cannot receive a change whose checks fail.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Behaviour-lock specs for every feature plus unit tests for domain logic
infrastructure_baseline.reason: The lock catches what users would notice; unit tests catch the rule that broke it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: E4 = 1 and every feature spec passes on the default branch.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Browser errors and slow requests are reported with a release tag (OpenTelemetry, or an error tracker)
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A vibe-coded app fails silently in the user's browser; nobody learns of it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every uncaught error reaches the tracker within a minute, tagged with the release.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Only publishable keys reach the browser; every secret lives in the host's secret store
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Anything bundled into the frontend is public.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No secret-class credential in the repository or the bundle (EAOS H1 finds none).

infrastructure_baseline.item: Automated, grouped dependency updates with the vulnerability scan in CI
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A locked vulnerable version stays until someone looks.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No locked version with a fixed high or critical advisory older than 14 days.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Supabase Auth with row-level security on every table the browser reaches
infrastructure_baseline.reason: The publishable key is public; RLS is the only thing between it and every row.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every table has RLS on and a policy per operation that binds the row to its owner.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Schema changes only as Supabase CLI migrations, applied by CI
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A table edited in the dashboard is a change nobody can review or repeat.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The database equals the migrations folder (supabase db diff is empty).

types.name: Python desktop application (a local UI packaged into an executable)

layers.name: ui
layers.responsibility: Screens and widgets (Streamlit views, Qt windows): read state, call services, render

layers.name: services
layers.responsibility: Use cases the UI calls; orchestrate domain and infrastructure

layers.name: domain
layers.responsibility: Rules and calculations with no I/O

infrastructure_baseline.item: Settings in the user's data directory (platformdirs), read once at start
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Writing next to the executable fails when it is installed read-only.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The app starts from a read-only install location.

infrastructure_baseline.item: One schema owner with versioned migrations for the local database
infrastructure_baseline.reason: An upgrade that changes a table silently corrupts old data files.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Opening a data file from any earlier release upgrades it or refuses with a message.

infrastructure_baseline.item: CI runs the tests and builds the executable on every push
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A packaging break is found by the user who downloads it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every release artefact is built by CI from a tagged commit.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Unit tests for domain calculations and approval tests for services
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Money and retirement maths must not change silently.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every public domain function is covered; the approval tests pass on the default branch.

infrastructure_baseline.item: A rotating local log with an export for support
infrastructure_baseline.reason: On a user's machine there is nothing else to look at.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every crash leaves a log with the version and the stack.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Any API token in the operating system keychain, never in the bundle
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A token in the executable belongs to everyone who has it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No credential in the repository or the built executable.

infrastructure_baseline.item: User data exported and restorable from the UI
infrastructure_baseline.reason: The only copy of a user's portfolio is on their disk.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: A backup restores into a clean install with identical totals.

types.name: Python web application (Streamlit, Flask, FastAPI, Django)

layers.name: web
layers.responsibility: Routes or pages: parse input, call services, render

infrastructure_baseline.item: Settings object (pydantic-settings or equivalent) read once
infrastructure_baseline.reason: os.environ reads scattered through handlers fail late.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No os.environ outside the settings module.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Migrations with Alembic or the framework's own
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Schema changes by hand cannot be repeated.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The database equals the migrations head.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Lint, types, tests and the EAOS gate on every push
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Changes regress silently otherwise.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The default branch cannot receive failing checks.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Behaviour lock plus unit tests for services
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Handlers change behaviour without anyone noticing.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: E4 = 1 and the suite passes on the default branch.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Structured logs and traces (OpenTelemetry) with request ids
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A failing request cannot be followed without them.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every error log carries a request id and a release.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Secrets from the host's store, never committed
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A committed key is a public key.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No secret-class credential in the repository.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Flags and one config file, validated at start
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A bad value should fail before work starts.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every invalid setting exits with code 2 and its name.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Inputs and outputs in documented formats with versions
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A format change breaks scripts that call the tool.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every output format has a schema version.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Tests on every push, on every supported Python
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A change breaks an older interpreter unseen.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The matrix passes on the default branch.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Unit tests plus approval tests of command output
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Output is the tool's interface.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every command has an approved output.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Exit codes that mean something, and --verbose logging
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A script calling the tool needs to know what failed.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every failure exits non-zero with a message on stderr.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Tokens from the environment or keychain only
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A token in a config file is committed sooner or later.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No credential in the repository.
